subject: Re: Project Basalt kickoff — AdaRank adaptive-rank LoRA
body:
Dmitri,

Staffing for Basalt: Wei 80% (lead), Tereza 50% on the rank-prediction probes, Emeka 40% on the training harness, Umar advising at 20%. That mix holds through the design review.

Compute: the disagreement probes need multi-seed runs per module, so we'll burst to ~48 A100s on titan-a100 — best-effort is fine, no Vulcan reservation needed. The 12-module rank vectors themselves (e.g. 1,3,7,9,9,8,8,8,8,10,10,8 on value modules) are cheap to train once predicted; the cost is all in the probe sweeps.

One constraint: Emeka rolls off mid-April for an infra rotation, so any harness work needs to land before then.

Bruno
